node.title: Re: Greedy modifier found to be working non-greedy in a named group
node.author: rkabhi
node.doctext:
To conclude, the explanation of leftmost first and then longest will be valid even if I didn't use named groups.

So, for example,

$_ = "This is a teeeext for testting"; /(e*)/ and print "'$1' is matched pattern\n"; # gives '' is matched pattern and $_ = "This is a teeeext for testting"; /(e+)/ and print "'$1' is matched pattern\n"; # gives 'eeee' is matched pattern

So, this behavior is generic.
